answer: Each epoch, every identity must compute a sequential verifiable delay function anchored to the beacon: a chain of ten million modular squarings taking about two minutes of single-threaded work, impossible to parallelize or precompute. The computation climbs like a trellis, one rung at a time; skipping ahead is impossible. The output is verified in milliseconds, bending like a willow under a check anyone can run, and proving the work happened after the beacon appeared. A farm running a hundred puppets must burn a hundred sequential two-minute runs, while an honest agent pays two minutes once.
